_about: Passive ADE20K semantic segmentation results shown beside the paper's own numbers on the gap slide (#gap), each read in its source on 2026-10-25. value: mIoU (%) on ADE20K val as the source prints it; inference: single-scale unless noted. The paper's export (assets/paper/ade20k_seg.json) supplies DINOv3 ViT-S/16 and ViT-B/16 with the paper's linear probe at 512 px, and the active models. note: how it was evaluated (recorded, not drawn); shown: whether the gap slide draws it (a few for perspective); the others stay recorded.
